description: Two-channel trigger sequencer in which each 8-step pattern is a whole number from 0 to 255, the eight bits of that number being the eight steps

params.text: Attenuverter over that channel's pattern CV, from fully inverted through nothing to full; the result is added to the number set by the SELECT knob
Chooses that channel's 8-step pattern as a number from 0 to 255; a change of pattern reaches the output on the next rising clock edge, so no stray triggers are made while scrolling
Chains the two patterns while it is on, so that OUT A plays pattern A then pattern B, sixteen steps in all

inputs.text: Each rising edge above 2V moves both channels on one step; the two channels stay locked to each other
A rising edge above 2V restarts both channels at step one on the next clock pulse
A gate above 2V lets the sequencer run and a level below 0.1V holds it; with nothing patched the sequencer runs
Shifts that channel's pattern number, by an amount set by that channel's CV knob; at the widest CV scale 10V covers the full 255, and the CV scale menu narrows that to 128, 64 or 32
A gate above 2V chains the two patterns, so that OUT A plays pattern A then pattern B, sixteen steps in all

outputs.text: Carries channel A's pattern, 10V on each step whose bit is set; the output mode menu makes those clock-width pulses, gates lasting the whole step, or 1ms triggers
Carries channel B's pattern, 10V on each step whose bit is set; with the patterns chained it can instead be silent, follow OUT A, or take the off beats, set by the chained pattern mode menu

menu: Output mode — leads to Channel A, Channel B or Both, each setting that channel's output to Clocks, Gates or Triggers
CV scale — leads to Channel A, Channel B or Both, setting how far 10V moves the pattern number: 0V - 10V = 0 - 255, 0 - 128, 0 - 64 or 0 - 32
Channel B chained pattern mode — sets what OUT B does while the patterns are chained: No output, Follow channel A or Inverse of channel A
Add CV expander — places an Octet Trigger Sequencer CV Expander to the right of this module
Add gate expander — places an Octet Trigger Sequencer Gate Expander to the right of this module

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
